## Overview

This Adyen PayMe Web page, captured 2026-09-15 and carrying a 2019-09-30 last-modified field, is a short integration chooser. It links Drop-in and Components child guides and general Web integration pages. It provides no PayMe-specific version, QR/app behavior, API fields, testing procedure, merchant eligibility, or payment outcome; those require their respective child evidence. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in child is labeled an all-in-one UI solution for adding PayMe to a website.
- The Components child is labeled a pre-built Component for rendering PayMe on a website. The page also points to general Web Drop-in and Components material, without choosing a Sessions or Advanced server-side flow.
